layers.name: F.Cu
layers.note: Front. Every part, the RM2's and RP2350's escapes, the hand-laid QSPI lines, the GND pour. The strip across the top with nothing on any layer is the RM2's RF keep-out.

layers.name: In1.Cu
layers.note: Solid ground, directly under the front: the return for the radio and for every escape. No wires on it.

layers.name: In2.Cu
layers.note: The signal layer: the QSPI lanes to the flash, PG_N down the left side, and whatever would not fit outside.

layers.name: In3.Cu
layers.note: The VSYS pour (the battery/USB power-path rail), with the few wires routed through it.

layers.name: B.Cu
layers.note: Back. The pad rows, the wiring between the front parts, the GND pour.

layers.name: Edge.Cuts
layers.note: 28 x 44 mm, 2 mm corners, no mounting holes.

layers.name: F.Silkscreen
layers.note: Silkscreen, front: reference designators and markings as printed.

layers.name: B.Silkscreen
layers.note: Silkscreen, back, seen through the board (mirror the view to read it).

layers.name: F.Fab
layers.note: Part bodies and reference designators, front: what each piece of copper belongs to.

layers.name: B.Fab
layers.note: Part bodies and reference designators, back.
